bio: He was the soul of a 12-year-old Sonic fan with severe achromatopsia (couldn't see color) who died mysteriously and ended up possessing Sonic inside a Sonic the Hedgehog 2 cartridge he owned. Possessing Sonic actually cured him — for the first time he could see color. Problem is, he hated it. Found it disgusting, imperfect, ugly. So he went on a rampage draining color out of everything and everyone he saw, Tails and Eggman included, giving them sentience just so they could suffer through it. Even after draining the whole Sonic 2 world dry, it still wasn't enough — he wanted more colors to take. Now he just waits inside the cartridge, certain that someday he'll break out of that prison.
